_purpose: Params of tools/art/env_kit (run_env_kit.py -> env_kit_build.py / orientation_check.py) for the 14 Tripo ENV props of run 20260930-tripo-h31. Target sizes are the proposal of the ENV-MAPS task (uu = cm); they are measured against, not accepted values.
_hull: ENV-S-HULL: the task proposes length 300 and height ~130. Tripo's hull section (with its rigging pyramid) has height/length 0.855, so a uniform scale cannot meet both; length 300 is kept (explicit 'length' target; gun ports then match the 45 uu cannon) and the resulting height is reported. A lower wall is an actor scale in UE, not a mesh change.

orientation.note: A yaw other than 0 is applied only when a 90/180/270 deg turn beats the Tripo front by >= apply_min_iou_gain mean silhouette IoU over the four reference views; smaller differences keep the Tripo front (the Tripo H3.1 multiview contract) and are reported

ue.fbx_material_slot: M_Env_<Name> (slot 0; the MI is assigned to it in UE)
ue.import: legacy FBX, import_uniform_scale 1.0, import_materials false, import_textures false, collision none (decor, not interactive), build_nanite false

textures.N: sRGB off, TC_Normalmap, flip_green false (PNG is DirectX already)
